summary.en: A page of decisions: each question has two options, the person's pick fills in the accent and its note appears; a summary box and an ink confirm block with a tick close the page; an ink frame walks the picks while it holds.
summary.zh: 一页决定：每个问题两个选项，人选中的那个填上强调色并出现注释；最后是汇总框和一块带勾的墨色确认块；停留时墨框在选项间走动。

fits: A chapter page where a person decides something the product then acts on: settings, reviews, approvals.
notFor: More than three questions; options longer than a short phrase; decisions the product makes alone (the accent means a person).

intent.en: Show that a person decides, and what: the accent fills the chosen option, so the viewer sees each decision being made.
intent.zh: 让人看到“是人在决定、决定了什么”：强调色填进被选的那项，每个决定都看得见。

content.en: Page head (number, title, caption), 1–3 questions with two options (≤ 16 chars) and a note, a summary (≤ 40 chars) and a confirm line.
content.zh: 页头（编号、标题、说明）、1–3 个问题各两个选项（≤ 8 字）和注释、一句汇总（≤ 16 字）和确认行。

fits.zh: 某章里由人做出、产品随后执行的决定：设置、评审、审批。

notFor.zh: 超过三个问题；选项长于短语；产品自己做的决定（强调色代表人）。

pairs.note: its pick carries into the loop's first node (block-carry)

en: The unpicked option must stay ink outline: filling both makes the accent stop meaning a decision.
zh: 没被选的选项要保持墨色描边；两个都填色，强调色就不再表示决定。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
